title: Origin story: Quicksilver Finn
description: Finn was a courier who prided himself on never being late, until the day he delivered a message that hadn't been sent yet — and realized he ran the roads of maybe, the paths between what is and what might be. Now he carries messages across possibility itself, arriving precisely when needed, sometimes before.
